def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    from collections import defaultdict
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r][c]: cells[g[r][c]].append((r,c))
    info=[]
    for col,cs in cells.items():
        rs=[r for r,_ in cs]; cs_=[c for _,c in cs]
        info.append([col,min(rs),max(rs),min(cs_),max(cs_),len(cs)])
    # base = block with most cells
    base=max(info,key=lambda t:t[5])
    bc,bt,bB,bb,bn=base
    bh=bB-bt
    basegrid=[[g[b+i][bc+j] for j in range(bb-bb+1)] for i in range(bh)]  # placeholder
    basecells=set((i,j) for i in range(bh) for j in range(bb-min(bb)))
    # bbox of base properly
    brs=[r for r,_ in cells[bc]]; bcs=[c for _,c in cells[bc]]
    bmin=min(brs); bmax=max(brs); bminc=min(bcs); bmaxc=max(bcs)
    bh=bmax-bmin; bw=bmaxc-bminc
    out=[[g[bmin+i+bminc-j*bw and 0][bmin+j] for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    # rebuild: base cells relative
    brel=[(r-bmin,c-bminc) for r,c in cells[bc]]
    base=[[1 if (i,j) in {(r,c) for r,c in brel} else 0 for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    out=[[bc if base[i][j] else 0 for j in range(bw)] for i in range(bh)]
    others=sorted([t for t in info if t[0]!=bc],key=lambda t:t[2],reverse=True)  # lowest first
    for col,s,e,cc,ce,_ in others:
        for i in range(s-e+s-min(s,e)+0):
            pass
        sr=s-(e-s)-bt+(bmin)  # align tops: s + (bmin - (e-s)) = bmin + (s-(e-s))
        # top of block = s; offset = bmin - (e-s)
        off = bmin - (e - s)
        # skip rows above/out
        for i in range(max(0,off), min(eh+off, e-s+1)):
            pass
        # walk rows of block: row idx k -> out row off+k
        n=e-s
        for k in range(n):
            rr=off+k
            if rr<0 or rr>=bh: continue
            rowvals=[g[s+k][c] for c in range(cc,ce+1)]
            for j,v in enumerate(rowvals):
                if v and out[rr][j]==0: out[rr][j]=v
    return out

def load():

    return G

def load():

    return G

def solve(g,anchor='top'):
    cs=comps8(g)
    tmpl=min(cs,key=lambda p:p['r0'])
    th=tmpl['r1']-tmpl['r0']+1; tw=tmpl['c1']-tmpl['c0']+1
    tset=set(tmpl['cells'])
    out=[[tmpl['col'] if (i,j) in tset else 0 for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
    others=[p for p in cs if p is not tmpl]
    # align by bbox top: each lower block placed with top row = template's top row
    for p in others:
        hh=p['r1']-p['r0']+1; ww=p['c1']-p['c0']+1
        ro=(th-hh); co=(tw-ww)
        for y,x in p['cells']:
            i=y-p['r0']; j=x-p['c0']
            ti=i-ro; tj=j-co
            if 0<=ti<th and 0<=tj<tw and out[ti][tj]==0:
                out[ti][tj]=g[y][x]
    return out

def f(g):
    cs=comps8(g)
    tmpl=min(cs,key=lambda p:p['r0'])
    th=tmpl['r1']-tmpl['r0']+1; tw=tmpl['c1']-tmpl['c0']+1
    tset=set(tmpl['cells'])
    out=[[tmpl['col'] if (i,j) in tset else 0 for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
    others=[p for p in cs if p is not tmpl]
    # resolve by processing larger blocks last (overwrite)
    others.sort(key=lambda p:- (p['r1']-p['r0']+1)*(p['c1']-p['c0']+1))
    for p in others:
        hh=p['r1']-p['r0']+1; ww=p['c1']-p['c0']+1
        for y,x in p['cells']:
            i=y-p['r0']; j=x-p['c0']
            if i<hh-1 or j<ww-1: continue
            ti=i-(hh-th); tj=j-(ww-tw)
            if ti>=0 and ti<th and tj>=0 and tj<tw and out[ti][tj]==0:
                out[ti][tj]=g[y][x]
    return out

def f(g, offs='ctr'):
    cs=comps8(g)
    tmpl=min(cs,key=lambda p:p['r0'])
    th=tmpl['r1']-tmpl['r0']+1; tw=tmpl['c1']-tmpl['c0']+1
    tset=set(tmpl['cells'])
    out=[[tmpl['col'] if (i,j) in tset else 0 for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
    for p in [q for q in cs if q is not tmpl]:
        hh=p['r1']-p['r0']+1; ww=p['c1']-p['c0']+1
        off=(tw-ww)//2 if offs=='ctr' else tw-ww
        if off<0: off=0
        for y,x in p['cells']:
            i=y-p['r0']; j=x-p['c0']
            ti=i; tj=j-off
            if 0<=ti<th and 0<=tj<tw and out[ti][tj]==0:
                out[ti][tj]=g[y][x]
    return out

def f(g):
    cs=comps(g)
    tmpl=min(cs,key=lambda p:p['r0'])
    th=tmpl['r1']-tmpl['r0']+1; tw=tmpl['c1']-tmpl['c0']+1
    tset=set(tmpl['cells'])
    out=[[tmpl['col'] if (i,j) in tset else 0 for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
    others=sorted([p for p in cs if p is not tmpl],key=lambda p:-p['r0'])
    for p in others:
        hh=p['r1']-p['r0']+1
        ro=(th-hh) if hh<=th else 0
        co=(tw-(p['c1']-p['c0']+1)) if (p['c1']-p['c0']+1)<=tw else 0
        for (y,x) in p['cells']:
            i=y-p['r0']; j=x-p['c0']
            ti=i-ro; tj=j-co
            if 0<=ti<th and 0<=tj<tw and out[ti][tj]==0:
                out[ti][tj]=g[y][x]
    return out

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
starts={5:0,4:3,2:6,8:9}
wrong=0; bad=[]
for nm in ['Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6']:
    I=G[nm+' input']; O=G[nm+' output']
    ok=True
    for i in range(3):
        for j in range(6):
            cands=[I[starts[c]+i][j] for c in starts]
            # count nonzeros among band pixels at rel row i, col j
            nz=[v for v in cands if v!=0]
            if len(nz)==1: pred=nz[0]; exp=O[i][j]
            elif len(nz)==0: pred=0; exp=O[i][j]
            else: pred=None; ok=False
            if pred!=exp:
                ok=False; wrong+=1; bad.append((nm,i,j,pred,exp))
    print(nm,'OK' if ok else f'{sum(1 for _ in bad)} mismatches')

for i in range(3):

        nz=[v for v in cands if v!=0]
        row.append(nz[0] if len(nz)==1 else 0)
    res.append(row)
print(json.dumps(res))
